preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
Length of each permutation array is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(T): len(A[i]) == len(P[i]) == N[i]
preconditions.description: Arrays A and P have the same length N.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(T): all(1 <= A[i][j] <= N[i] for j in range(N[i]))
preconditions.description: Elements of A are distinct integers from 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(T): all(1 <= P[i][j] <= N[i] for j in range(N[i]))
preconditions.description: Elements of P are distinct integers from 1 to N.
Number of operations is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(T): for j in range(Q[i]): operations[i][j][0] in {1, 2, 3}
preconditions.description: Each operation type is either 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(T): for j in range(Q[i]): if operations[i][j][0] == 2: 1 <= operations[i][j][1] <= N[i] and 1 <= operations[i][j][2] <= N[i] and operations[i][j][1] != operations[i][j][2]
preconditions.description: For swap operations, x and y are distinct and within the range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: for i in range(T): for j in range(Q[i]): if operations[i][j][0] == 3: 1 <= operations[i][j][1] <= N[i]
preconditions.description: For query operations, x is within the range [1, N].

postconditions.expression: for i in range(T): for j in range(Q[i]): if operations[i][j][0] == 3: output[i][j] == A[i][operations[i][j][1] - 1]
postconditions.description: For each query operation, output the element at position x in array A after all preceding operations have been applied.
